LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 49-2026
HERCULES TRANSPORT, INC.
EX PARTE
In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC Nos. 8217 & 8220 
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC Nos. 8217 & 8220 per a notarized
affidavit received on June 30, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC Nos. 8217 & 8220 held
by Hercules Transport, Inc. are hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees
and fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.
(Decided June 30, 2026)

Joint Written Consent of the Board of Directors and Shareholders 
September 30, 2004 
Pursuant to the authority contained in Sections 76 and 81C)9) of Title 12 of the 
Louisiana Revised Statutes, as amended (the "LRS'), the undersigned, being all of the members 
of the board of directors and all of the shareholders of Hercules Transport, Inc., a Louisiana 
corporation (the "Corporation"), hereby approve, consent to, and adopt the following recitals 
and resolutions and the actions therein authorized as the act of the Corporation's board of 
directors and the Corporation's shareholders by written consent. 
Proper Officers 
RESOLVED, that for the purposes of these resolutions, the term "Proper Officer" shall 
mean Thomas M. O'Neal, President of the Corporation ("O'Neal). 
Articles of Amendment 
WHEREAS, O'Neal and his three sisters, Jo Ann O'Neal Brueggeman, Pamela Redmond 
O'Neal Rundle and Martha Jane O'Neal McAfee (collectively, the "Sisters"), each own 150 
shares of the Corporation's outstanding common stock; 
WHEREAS, O'Neal desires to purchase the 450 shares of the Corporation's common 
stock held by the Sisters for an aggregate of $2,025,000 in cash, each of the Sisters receiving 
$675,000 or $4,500 per share pursuant to a Stock Purchase Agreement (the "SPA4") dated as of 
September 30, 2004; 
WHEREAS, Article VI of the Corporation's articles of incorporation (the "Articles") 
requires any shareholder who desires to sell their shares to an individual other than a "permitted 
transferee," as such term is defined in the Articles, to offer such shares to the Corporation for 
purchase and allows the Corporation fifteen ( 15) days to decide whether to accept the offer, 
WHEREAS, in connection with the purchase of the Sister's shares by O'Neal, the 
Corporation's board of directors and shareholders desire to amend the Articles by deleting 
Article VI in its entirety; 
WHEREAS, the Corporation's board of directors and shareholders have received, read 
and considered the form of the articles of amendment to the Articles, attached hereto as 
Exhibit A (the "Articles of Amendment"); 
WHEREAS, the Corporation's board of directors deems it advisable and in the 
Corporation's best interest that the Articles be amended to remove Article VI and to renumber 
Articles VII and VIII as Articles VI and VII, respectively; and

General Authorization 
RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Proper Officer be, and hereby is, authorized, 
empowered and directed, for and in the name and on behalf of the Corporation, to take such 
steps, to perform all such acts and things, and to prepare, execute, swear to, acknowledge, and 
deliver any and all documents, instruments, certificates, waivers and consents which may, by law 
or to him or legal counsel to the Corporation seem necessary, convenient or appropriate to fulfill 
the intent of the foregoing resolutions, including, without limitation, the filing of the Articles of 
Amendment as required under the LRS, such necessity, convenience or appropriateness to be 
conclusively evidenced by the taking or performance of any of the foregoing steps, acts and 
things, executions and filings. 
Counterparts 
RESOLVED FURTHER, that this Joint Written Consent of the Board of Directors and 
Shareholders may be executed in multiple counterparts and by means of original or facsimile 
signature by the board of directors and the shareholders of the Corporation.
